scope: Worker source and authored-contact QA only. Manager visual acceptance pending. No runtime integration or clinical semantics.

001.method: Sol v6b worker visually inspected all 80 normalized seated poses on dark backgrounds at 2x with ten-pixel grid lines. South contacts estimate support through the hidden pelvis from the thigh junction; east/west/north contacts follow the underside of the pelvis. Skirt and tunic contacts estimate pelvic support, not the lowest hanging hem. The cane is visual only and is not used to infer seat support. These are manually chosen worker anchors pending manager acceptance, not inferred percentages.
